label: thm:prime_list_correct
title: Correctness of the prime list
statement: After the sieve terminates, the output list $\mathrm{primes}$ is a prime list up to $n$.
proof: By the same induction as for \ref{thm:lpf_correct}. The invariant at $n+1$ ensures the prime list contains all primes up to $n$ and is strictly increasing.
